card.name: Words just before injection or dosing details
card.fires_on: Small connecting or verb words in injection-related label text, right before a dose, time window, or treatment detail (e.g. 'within', 'recommends', 'consider', 'or'). Also fires partway through words like procedural or lactated.

modes.label: Linking words before timing or dose
modes.description: Words like within, or, or the blank space before a number in infusion and injection instructions.
modes.example: Symptoms typically appear<< within>> 1 to 6 hours after treatment

modes.label: Verbs introducing a recommendation
modes.description: Verbs such as recommends or consider that lead into a guidance statement.
modes.example: If concomitant use is warranted,<< consider>> prescribing an opioid overdose reversal agent

modes.label: Inside injection-setting terms
modes.description: Partway through words like procedural or lactated, in sedation or fluid-injection text.
modes.example: Avoid Lact<<ated>> Ringer’s Injection in patients at risk
